jade/bar.prompt:
A UI frame of the bar of the jade UI style for a xianxia cultivation saga of sects, flying swords and jade pavilions above the clouds: a panel's border and ground, its centre plain so text reads on it.
Style: Luminous layered depths. Painterly side-on scenery in many foreground and background layers with strong luminous focal points against dark masses. Deep side-on layers, glowing focal points, light shafts and bloom, atmospheric fade into the distance.
Palette: dark cool masses plus warm luminous accents; value structure first: dark foreground, mid play plane, glowing background.
Nine-slice: the corners (19% left, 25% top, 19% right, 25% bottom of each cell) keep their size, the edges between them stretch along one axis and the centre both ways: put every ornament in the corners, keep the edges even along their length and the centre plain.
Background: fully transparent, nothing outside the subject.
Line: none to 1.
Reference: the image shows the style; match its palette, line and rendering, not its content.
Avoid: flat single-layer backgrounds; bright overall exposure; no focal light; a background or ground shadow; text, letters or watermarks.
Shape: one single bar only, centred, filling the image across its width, 4.00 times as wide as it is tall (64 x 16 proportions); nothing else in the image.
Art direction: A meter's fill painted as one confident dry-brush stroke of ink in white and light greys only (the game tints it with the meter's colour): a bold, even band across the whole width, its left and right ends ragged and split into bristle marks where the brush landed and lifted, a few faint fibre streaks along its length, its middle a flat even near-white so it tints cleanly. As the brush-stroke health and inner-qi bars of the ink-wash concept. Its top and bottom edges are even along their whole length (they stretch): the ragged marks sit only at its two ends. The stroke alone fills the image from edge to edge and nearly its full height: no scenery anywhere, no mountains, pavilions, trees, clouds, waves, mist, seals or any picture, at its ends or behind it, and no frame or outline around it. Clear background, nothing else.
The reference images are the approved concept of this style's screens: paint this piece as it appears there, in their exact material, colour, ornament and finish; do not copy their layout or text.
